oi_source: NSE official participant-wise EOD OI CSV archive
price_source: Yahoo Finance daily open and close (^NSEI)
target_definition: OI change known after EOD on date t; entry is the next trading session open and exit is that session close for horizon 1, or the close of the 3rd/5th subsequent session for horizons 3/5. No same-day close entry.
normalization: Separate long and short leg changes, plus net change, each divided by that participant/field's previous-session gross OI (long + short), in percent.

validation.chronological_split: first 70% train; last 30% holdout, ordered by date
validation.directional_hit_rate: reported for futures net OI and futures long/short changes (short changes are sign-inverted); call/put OI is correlation-only because option-side long/short positions are not a clean directional proxy.
validation.reason: Exploratory sample only. No OI weight or trading score is assigned. Require longer history and stable chronological holdout performance before considering any live score contribution.
